h1: RV vent crank handle replacement, matched to your shaft
answer_first: We print replacement crank knobs for manual RV roof vents, including Ventline, Elixir and Hehr style vents, in UV-resistant ASA, matched to your shaft or spline. Send a photo and your measurements and we quote within 24 hours on business days, from $16.
fits: Fits Ventline, Elixir-style and Hehr-style manual roof vents
Matched to a splined shaft or a 1/2 in shaft, from your measurements
problem: Plastic crank knobs strip where they grip the shaft, so the handle spins without opening the vent. The knobs sit in the sun for years and turn brittle. The fit depends on the exact spline or shaft size, which varies between makers.
oem_situation: A Ventline operator with crank, BVD0462-00, was listed at $23.14 and out of stock. One etrailer answer says Ventline Northern Breeze vents are discontinued with no replacement parts. Ventline spline also differs from Jensen, so a generic knob may not fit. We price from $16.
our_part: We print in ASA, a plastic made to resist sun and heat. We need the shaft type and size, which you measure yourself: spline or round, with the diameter, plus the knob diameter and a photo with a coin or ruler. We match the shaft opening to your measurements and tell you if anything looks unclear before we print.

faqs.a: If we have a photo of your shaft and its measured size, we can match it. We confirm the fit with you before printing.

faqs.q: Is a printed knob as strong as the original?
faqs.a: We do not claim it matches the original. Printed ASA is strong in most directions but weakest where the layers pull apart, so we orient the print to put the load along the layers. We tell you if a part is a poor candidate.

faqs.q: How do I measure the shaft?
faqs.a: Photograph the shaft end from the side and straight on with a coin or ruler beside it. Tell us if it is splined or round, measure the diameter across it, and measure the old knob diameter. Send the vent make or model number if you have it.

faqs.q: My shaft is splined. Does that matter?
faqs.a: Yes. Spline patterns differ between makers, and Ventline spline differs from Jensen. A clear straight-on photo of the shaft end is the most useful thing you can send.
Yes. Tell us how many vents you have and we quote a lower price per knob.
